summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K reporting an open-market share buyback under its 5 August 2026 program, purchasing 850,800 ordinary shares from BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$156.30–HK$158.40, volume-weighted average HK$157.3554. Since program inception, 46,874,702 shares have been repurchased for approximately US$962.0 million. Repurchased shares are cancelled, leaving 17,141,942,291 ordinary shares outstanding and no treasury shares. No board recommendation or advisor is named beyond BNP Paribas as broker. The Hong Kong repurchases are 'off market' under the Companies Act 2006 but on-exchange for HK listing rules; cancellation timing differs from UK venues. Watch for continued daily repurchase disclosures and the updated total voting rights once HK shares are cancelled.
